name.hi: यूपी कृत्रिम अंग एवं सहायक उपकरण / मोटराइज्ड ट्राईसाइकिल योजना
name.en: UP Kritrim Ang / Sahayak Upkaran Yojana (Assistive Devices & Motorised Tricycles)

bilingual_title.en: UP Kritrim Ang / Sahayak Upkaran Yojana (Assistive Devices & Motorised Tricycles)
bilingual_title.hi: यूपी कृत्रिम अंग एवं सहायक उपकरण / मोटराइज्ड ट्राईसाइकिल योजना

eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Uttar Pradesh domicile/UP Family ID (familyid.up.gov.in) required across all 75 districts (incl. UP NCR: Noida/Gautam Buddha Nagar, Ghaziabad, Hapur, Meerut, Bulandshahr, Baghpat); Delhi NCT & Haryana excluded.
eligibility_criteria.age_range: As per scheme rules / age eligibility criteria
eligibility_criteria.income_cap: Per official department notification / income slab criteria
eligibility_criteria.academic_or_work_rules: As specified in official scheme notification
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Applicants not meeting statutory residency/income/category rules or claiming overlapping benefit

benefit.summary_hi: 40%+ दिव्यांगजनों को निःशुल्क ट्राईसाइकिल, मोटराइज्ड ट्राईसाइकिल, व्हीलचेयर, श्रवण यंत्र व कृत्रिम अंग वितरण।
benefit.summary_en: Free artificial limbs, tricycles, motorised tricycles, wheelchairs, hearing aids & smart canes up to notified value for >=40% PwD in UP.

benefit_summary.en: Free artificial limbs, tricycles, motorised tricycles, wheelchairs, hearing aids & smart canes up to notified value for >=40% PwD in UP.
benefit_summary.hi: 40%+ दिव्यांगजनों को निःशुल्क ट्राईसाइकिल, मोटराइज्ड ट्राईसाइकिल, व्हीलचेयर, श्रवण यंत्र व कृत्रिम अंग वितरण।

documents_required: सीएमओ (मुख्य चिकित्सा अधिकारी) द्वारा जारी दिव्यांगता प्रमाण पत्र (न्यूनतम 40%)

application_steps.offline: Submit verified documents at nearest Jan Seva Kendra (CSC) / e-Sathi (esathi.up.gov.in) + UP Family ID
application_steps.facilitation_center: Jan Seva Kendra (CSC) / e-Sathi (esathi.up.gov.in) + UP Family ID

anti_dalal.official_fee: ₹0 (Official government portal application is free unless statutory challan is notified)
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_hi: जन सेवा केंद्र पर निर्धारित ई-डिस्ट्रिक्ट शुल्क (₹15–₹30) से अधिक न दें व पक्की रसीद लें
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_en: Jan Seva Kendra official e-District charge only (always collect Application Tracking Slip)
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
